module: Editor extension that enables "Camera V2", an alternative set of mouse controls for the World Editor free camera (pan, orbit, zoom, planar WASD). It registers as a camera controller (core/cameraControllerRegistry, id "editor.cameraV2") only when the camera.general.activeCamera preference is "cameraV2" or when setTemporaryEnabled(true) has been called, and the editor is active. It declares the camera.cameraV2.* preferences, shows a debug window and can recover a camera with invalid coordinates. The real work is delegated to editor/cameraV2/controller.
notes: camera.cameraV2.* preferences (default): swapPanOrbitButtons (bool, true: right click = pan, wheel click = orbit), orbitAroundViewCenter (bool, true), wasdMode ('standard' or 'pan', default 'standard'), wasdPanSpeedMultiplier (0.5), wasdPanFastSpeedMultiplier (1.5), showDebugWindow (bool, false), zoomFactorPerNotch (1.5), zoomMinDistance (0.25 m), zoomMaxDistance (2500 m), zoomResponse (20), inertiaDuration (0.35 s).
If the camera pose is invalid (NaN, > 1e7 m, invalid quaternion) onUpdate calls recoverCamera() and aborts the frame if recovery fails.
onUpdate limits the dt passed to the controller to 0.05 s.
When the camera is above 1500 m in height, a red reference cylinder is drawn from the origin (placed on the terrain) up to zoomMaxDistance.

setTemporaryEnabled.desc: Forces Camera V2 to be enabled regardless of the preference (useful for a tool that wants these controls temporarily). Updates the controller registration state.

enabled.desc: true to enable, anything else is treated as false

consumeFocusDoubleClick.desc: If Camera V2 is registered, relays controller.consumeFocusDoubleClick() (focus double click consumed or not).

returns.desc: false if Camera V2 is not active

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Preferences registration hook: creates the "camera" category, the "general" subcategory (activeCamera: stock or cameraV2) and "cameraV2" (preferences above), and reorders the subcategories.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the "cameraV2Debug" debug window (360x250 scaled) then evaluates the activation state.

onEditorActivated.desc: Called when the editor is activated; reevaluates the Camera V2 activation state.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Called when the editor is deactivated; turns off planar translation and unregisters the controller.

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Reacts to preference changes: activeCamera reevaluates activation, wasdMode resynchronizes the WASD mode, showDebugWindow shows/hides the window, any other camera.cameraV2.* preference cancels the controller's current gesture.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame. If Camera V2 is active: validates/recovers the pose, updates the controller with dt limited to 0.05 s, draws the altitude reference and the pivot markers (red orbit sphere, blue pan cylinder).

dtReal.desc: Real-time delta in seconds; defaults to ui_imgui.GetIO().DeltaTime

onEditorGui.desc: Draws the "Camera V2 Debug" window (Recover Camera button, controller state, cursor/center ray distances, height above terrain, zoom settings) if showDebugWindow is not false and the controller is registered.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: On unload: turns off planar mode, unregisters the controller and the debug window.
